7943.title: Sequential daemon-message validation
7943.rootCauseOneLine: An ordered 18-member message union and nested RPC union validate unrelated alternatives before reaching the matching message.
7943.proposedFix: Dispatch the outer validator by type and nested RPC responses by ok, preserving field checks and reviewing diagnostic compatibility.
7943.caveats: Schema-level reproduction repeated by the same agent in two clean checkouts; no live throughput measurement. No automatic fix because exported protocol validation schemas are outside the rule's simple-fix boundary. Reproduction script and output are inline per report-site policy.
